title: Final Max Intensity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the maximum intensity I_max/I_0 as 0.08.

title: Final Min Intensity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the minimum intensity I_min/I_0 as 0.

title: Reflectivity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly compute the reflectivity R using the given formula.

title: Phase Difference Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the phase difference delta correctly based on the film thickness and wavelength.

title: Intensity Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately apply the intensity formula for interference in thin films.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect sign in the phase difference or miscalculating reflectivity.
